result.title: Analysis of Keytruda US FDA Regulatory Announcements
commercial_relevance: Regulatory approvals expand Keytruda and Keytruda Qlex into additional indications such as perioperative muscle-invasive bladder cancer, first-line TNBC, adjuvant clear-cell renal cell carcinoma, and platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian-related carcinoma.
Label expansions increase the eligible patient population across multiple oncology settings.
follow_up_questions: What are the projected patient population sizes for each newly approved indication?
How will adoption rates vary across community versus academic oncology practices for these new regimens?
limitations: Exact future revenue calculations cannot be reliably estimated from regulatory announcement records alone.
Trial snapshots were not retrieved; therefore, trial IDs are omitted.

facts.title: Pembrolizumab with chemoradiotherapy for cervical cancer
facts.population_summary: FIGO 2014 Stage III-IVA cervical cancer; regimen includes chemoradiotherapy.
evidence_notes: The approval population is Stage III-IVA; the supporting trial also enrolled node-positive Stage IB2-IIB patients.

facts.title: Pembrolizumab with chemotherapy for endometrial carcinoma
facts.population_summary: Adults with primary advanced or recurrent endometrial carcinoma; carboplatin and paclitaxel followed by pembrolizumab alone.
evidence_notes: Supporting trial enrolled separate dMMR and pMMR cohorts; the approval paragraph does not restrict to dMMR.

facts.title: Pembrolizumab with chemotherapy for pleural mesothelioma
facts.population_summary: First-line treatment of unresectable advanced or metastatic malignant pleural mesothelioma with pemetrexed and platinum chemotherapy.
evidence_notes: Pleural mesothelioma; do not broaden this announcement to peritoneal mesothelioma.

facts.title: Pembrolizumab for HER2-positive gastric or GEJ cancer
facts.population_summary: Traditional approval with trastuzumab and fluoropyrimidine/platinum chemotherapy for first-line adult locally advanced unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma expressing PD-L1 CPS at least 1.
evidence_notes: Conversion from prior accelerated approval; do not count as a first-ever pembrolizumab approval.

facts.title: Perioperative pembrolizumab for resectable HNSCC
facts.population_summary: Adults with resectable locally advanced HNSCC with PD-L1 CPS at least 1; pembrolizumab before surgery, then with radiotherapy with or without cisplatin, followed by pembrolizumab alone.
evidence_notes: Do not remove the PD-L1 CPS restriction.

facts.title: Pembrolizumab plus enfortumab vedotin for cisplatin-ineligible MIBC
facts.population_summary: Cisplatin-ineligible adults with muscle-invasive bladder cancer; pembrolizumab or Qlex with enfortumab vedotin before surgery and after cystectomy.
evidence_notes: Supporting trial also allowed patients who declined cisplatin, but the approval paragraph specifies cisplatin ineligibility.

facts.title: Pembrolizumab plus paclitaxel for platinum-resistant ovarian-related carcinoma
facts.population_summary: Adults with platinum-resistant epithelial ovarian, fallopian-tube, or primary-peritoneal carcinoma expressing PD-L1 CPS at least 1 after one or two prior systemic regimens; paclitaxel with or without bevacizumab.
evidence_notes: Both IV pembrolizumab and Qlex are named.

facts.title: Belzutifan plus pembrolizumab for adjuvant clear-cell RCC
facts.population_summary: Adults with RCC with a clear-cell component and intermediate-high or high recurrence risk after nephrectomy, including specified resected metastatic lesions; belzutifan with pembrolizumab or Qlex.
evidence_notes: Overall-survival data were immature at the protocol prespecified interim analysis.

facts.title: Sacituzumab govitecan plus pembrolizumab for first-line TNBC
facts.population_summary: Combination indication: adults with unresectable locally advanced or metastatic TNBC expressing PD-L1 CPS at least 10; sacituzumab govitecan with pembrolizumab or Qlex.
evidence_notes: This page announces two indications. ASCENT-03 supports sacituzumab monotherapy in patients unsuitable for PD-1/PD-L1 therapy; ASCENT-04 supports the pembrolizumab combination.

facts.title: Pembrolizumab plus enfortumab vedotin expands perioperative MIBC eligibility
facts.population_summary: Adults with muscle-invasive bladder cancer who are cystectomy candidates; pembrolizumab or Qlex plus enfortumab vedotin before and after surgery.
evidence_notes: Extends the prior cisplatin-ineligible approval to all MIBC patients who are candidates for cystectomy. Supporting trial enrolled cisplatin-eligible patients.

events.title: Pembrolizumab plus enfortumab vedotin for cisplatin-ineligible MIBC

events.title: Adjuvant cemiplimab for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma

events.title: Lurbinectedin plus atezolizumab maintenance for extensive-stage SCLC

events.title: Perioperative pembrolizumab for resectable HNSCC
